item.title: The Garbage Collection Handbook: The Art of Automatic Memory Management (2nd Ed) (2023)
item.description:
📝 Second edition Richard Jones’s Garbage Collection (Wiley, 1996) was a milestone book in the area of automatic memory management. Along with simple and traditional algorithms, the book covers state-of-the-art parallel, incremental, concurrent and real-time garbage collection. Web Resources The online bibliographic database includes nearly 3,400 garbage collection-related publications.
🔗 Read more: https://gchandbook.org/

item.title: Military branches restore flu shot requirement after virus swept through base
item.description:
📝 But in April, Hegseth claimed that flu shot requirements were “not rational” and said removing the requirement was “restoring freedom” to military members. ABC News reported that sources think only about 40 percent of the new Air Force trainees at the base were vaccinated and that the outbreak began in early June. Beth Mole Senior Health Reporter Beth Mole Senior Health Reporter Beth is Ars Technica’s Senior Health Reporter.
